==About==

A {{i|Carrot}} is received by chance when picking up a recently killed {{i|Dead Rabbit}}, or, with the [[Vegetable Potting]] Skill learned, a Carrot can be grown by planting another Carrot in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. Planting Vegetables in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. Feeding a Carrot to a {{i|Sheep}} will lower its [[Domesticated Animals#Temperament|Temperament]]. A Carrot can be stored in a {{i|Veggie Sack}}.
